description: § 823 BGB in legislative materials: only a fragment whose heading targets § 823 BGB 'explains' it; a fragment that merely names § 823 BGB in its body 'mentions' it, also when its heading explains another BGB norm (§ 826). A target repeated in the body stays 'explains' and is not duplicated as a mention. FIXTURE IS SYNTHETIC: no captured material citing § 823 BGB exists in Kerf's fixtures, so conformance/fixtures/kerf/materials-synthetic-823-bgb reproduces the exact layout of the captured Gegenäußerung pages of BT-Drs. 19/13824 (pages 312/314) under the fictitious Drucksache 99/823 (see its meta.json).
